title: Great all use spatula
text: Great all use spatula. This is a really nice, reasonably priced, spatula. Well made and very heat resistant. I have used it in my kitchen with my frying and crepe pans and I have also used it for turning hamburgers on the grill with no problem or 'melting' of the rubber. It is a nice size as well, easy to store and washes well in the dish washer. Highly recommend.
